2609.03702.title: Synthetic Semantic Supervision for Contrastive Code Representation Learning in Small Transformers: An Empirical Study
2609.03702.paper_summary: General-purpose code embeddings power tools for code search, classification, and retrieval. Compact transformer encoders for code typically rely on either human-written docstrings (labor-intensive and inconsistent) or mined structural signals such as execution traces (setting-specific and costly to collect). We empirically study an alternative: contrastive pretraining of small encoders with synthetically generated natural-language descriptions emphasizing code functionality and intent, paired with code in a dual-encoder framework at training and discarded at inference. We benchmark this approach against pretraining-based baselines, generalist LLMs, and embedding-specific models on eight retrieval, classification, and generation tasks across C, C++, and Java. Synthetic semantic supervision yields statistically significant gains over pretraining baselines of the same inference-time size on five of eight tasks, with parity on two more; once fine-tuned, it matches or exceeds zero-shot models two orders of magnitude larger on classification, and it stays on par with execution-aware supervision at matched pretraining data, suggesting a scalable, effective alternative to existing code-representation paradigms.
2609.03702.paper_summary_zh: 通用的代碼嵌入技術為代碼搜索、分類和檢索工具提供支持。針對代碼的緊湊型Transformer編碼器通常依賴於人類編寫的文檔字符串（勞動密集且不一致）或挖掘的結構信號，如執行痕跡（特定於設置且收集成本高）。我們實證研究了一種替代方案：對小型編碼器進行對比預訓練，使用合成生成的自然語言描述，強調代碼功能和意圖，並在訓練中與代碼配對，推理時則丟棄。 我們將這種方法與基於預訓練的基準、通用 LLM 和嵌入特定模型在 C、C++ 和 Java 的八個檢索、分類和生成任務上進行基準測試。合成語義監督在八個任務中的五個上相較於相同推理時間大小的預訓練基準產生了統計上顯著的增益，另外兩個任務則持平；一旦進行微調，它在分類上達到或超過了零樣本模型的兩個數量級，並且在匹配的預訓練數據下與執行感知監督保持一致，這表明這是一種可擴展且有效的替代現有代碼表示範式的方案。
